#### 5 Line Biologics

If you are faced with choosing between multiple distributors representing many of the same top
manufacturers, then as both a consumer and a clinician, you should have two basic questions. First,
can they decrease my overall costs? Second, are their standards as high as mine?

#### Our Approach

We understand how complex and confusing the regenerative medicine space can be.

[ Read More ][20]

Whether you’re brand new to Regenerative Medicine or have been here for years, we can help.

[ Get In Touch ][21]

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Here are some great questions you have on your mind!

Does a distributor need to be registered with the state of NJ to sell medical devices there?

Yes. [NJAC 8:21-3A][22] is the applicable statute. You can verify a distribution
business [here][23]. Our registration number is 5005403.

Does my practice require a blood bank license to prepare PRP?

Yes. Under the provisions of [NJSA 26:2A][24] you will be required to obtain a blood bank license
for perioperative autologous blood collection/administration. It is a fairly easy process and we are
happy to help guide you through this.

Please call us at [609-975-9884][25] or send an e-mail to [info@5linemed.com][26] to request more
information.

[[5 line Biologics logo][5 line Biologics logo]][27]

We provide full in-service product support. We also offer one-on-one training conducted through
partner physicians experienced with these types of procedures. We will provide this training in your
office.

  Primary Cells
  
  Primary cells are isolated from fresh tissues, which can maintain the basic properties of the
  original cells. Therefore, as an in vitro experimental model, primary cells are widely used in
  basic research of molecular, cell biology and biomedicine, such as proteomics, genomics and
  genetics, and also in drug screening, drug metabolism and toxicology, cancer drug research, etc.
  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.

### Culturing Innovative Partnerships

###### ADVENT BIOSERVICES


###### CONTRACT DEVELOPMENT & MANUFACTURING ORGANISATION (CDMO)

#### Your ideal partner in cell therapy

Advent Bioservices began activity as a cell therapy Contract Development & Manufacturing
Organisation (CDMO) in 2016. We are currently managing the development of a state-of-the-art
facility for multiproduct Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) production outside Sawston in
Cambridgeshire, which will allow scale up of current commercial production and initiate the
provision of contract manufacturing services to meet the growing demand for such services in the
UK. 

 

The Sawston facility is perfectly positioned in the ‘UK golden triangle’ for cell and gene therapy,
our facility is located just 7 miles outside Cambridge city centre with excellent transport links to
Central London, London Stansted airport and it is 4 miles from the M11 motorway, linking to the
Midlands by the new A14 extension.

 

The facility consists of 2 separate GMP suites with grade B/C classified areas, in house QC testing,
process development laboratories, warehouse and office space as well as a multipurpose cold storage
and cryogenic storage unit. 

 

We operate the facility under a comprehensive IT infrastructure including EMS,  eQMS eBMR and LIMS
systems with secure storage for client documents and paperless systems. Our cleanroom suites are
fully validated, with an in-house environmental monitoring system. Clients utilising our
manufacturing service will benefit from ancillary services and technical support inclusive of
process development, QC and validation. Ultra-cold and cryogenic facilities are available to
external clients as off-site storage and are fully GMP compliant.

.

Why Choose Us?

## Why Choose Us?

Important values we share with our partners...

[Scalability.png]

#### SCALABILITY

We can help you solve your scale up difficulties and can support your expansion across multiple
areas including research and development,  process development, higher volume manufacturing and
meeting regulatory standards.

[Boundaries.png]

#### EXPANDED

#### POTENTIAL

We can develop to meet your need, wherever they are. With our global mindset, Advent Bioservices can
break down borders ensuring the best possible outcome at every stage of your journey.

[Benchmarks.png]

#### REGULATORY COMPLIANCE

We operate to the highest industry standards with expertise in regulatory standards including HTA,
MHRA and JACIE. We are GMP and GLP compliant and strive to reach the best quality output. We are
here to help you ensure that your process complies with relevant standards.

[HumanTouch.png]

#### THE PERSONAL TOUCH

The Advent Bioservices team is conscientious, professional and easy to communicate with. We nurture
our business with respect for our clients needs. We have a happy and healthy business culture.

[Discovery.png]

#### DISCOVERY

Research and development plays a vital part in the advancement of the growth of the cell and gene
therapies industry. We can help you by focusing on innovation and optimisation, attending to your
individual requirements.

[HealthPartners.png]

#### CULTURING PARTNERSHIPS

In the complex biosciences industry, having people that you trust is essential. Our priorities are
focused on building long-term partnerships and supporting our clients.

## Some positive words

#### “Coming to work knowing we are contributing to improving another person’s quality of life is
#### unbelievably rewarding. On top of that coming to a company who offer tremendous opportunities
#### for both professional and personal development is just wonderful”

- Alia Klyn. Production Scientist.

Services & Facilites

## Services & Facilities

The UK cell and gene therapy industry is expanding at a rapid rate. In the last 5 years, cleanroom
space increased annually to a current total of 7819 sq m and the UK initiated 112 new ATMP clinical
trials - the highest number for all European countries. This has resulted in strong demand for GMP
manufacturing services, expertise in commercialisation and scale up of manufacture.

## Alacrita is a biotech and pharma consulting firm
## built on real-world experience.

Our consultants have led programs discovering, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing drug
products, bringing the practical insight and execution expertise that only come from having done the
work themselves. Our core team draws on a network of more than 350 experienced specialists across 29
functional disciplines, brought into projects when their expertise is directly relevant. This model
allows us to assemble the right team quickly, stay adaptable as projects evolve, and provide
precisely relevant support at the level each client requires.

**We support clients across three core areas: product development, enterprise development, and
business development.**

For more than fifteen years, we've helped life-science organizations solve complex scientific and
operational challenges, make critical business and investment decisions, strengthen leadership
capacity, and advance their programs with the rigor and judgment of experienced industry

## Alacrita is a biotech and pharma consulting firm
## built on real-world experience.

Our consultants have led programs discovering, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing drug
products, bringing the practical insight and execution expertise that only come from having done the
work themselves. Our core team draws on a network of more than 350 experienced specialists across 29
functional disciplines, brought into projects when their expertise is directly relevant. This model
allows us to assemble the right team quickly, stay adaptable as projects evolve, and provide
precisely relevant support at the level each client requires.

**We support clients across three core areas: product development, enterprise development, and
business development.**

For more than fifteen years, we've helped life-science organizations solve complex scientific and
operational challenges, make critical business and investment decisions, strengthen leadership
capacity, and advance their programs with the rigor and judgment of experienced industry
professionals and the agility to adapt as needs evolve.

to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

## Uniting Innovators in Cell and Gene Therapy

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a
wide range of conditions.

### Data that drives the sector forward

trends, giving the CGT community and our stakeholders the insight needed to make informed, strategic
decisions.

# Convening the Cell and Gene Therapy Community

ARM unites the cell and gene therapy ecosystem to modernize healthcare systems, overcome obstacles
to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

[ Join ARM ][119]
[Hero Illustration] [Mobile Hero Illustration]

## Uniting Innovators in Cell and Gene Therapy

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

[ Learn More About ARM ][120]
[Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics]

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

We support our members in advancing living medicines that target the root causes of
disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a
wide range of conditions.

[Data that drives the sector forward]

### Data that drives the sector forward

Our data and reports track the global pipeline, clinical trials, regulatory shifts, and funding
trends, giving the CGT community and our stakeholders the insight needed to make informed, strategic
decisions.

## ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids
## Access to Care Act

These policies, which became law with President Trump’s signature, represent hope for the rare
disease community and will meaningfully improve access to life-changing and life-saving treatments.

We applaud Congress for passing ARM’s top two legislative priorities and are grateful to our partner
organizations whose collaboration and advocacy were crucial in securing the necessary support.

[ Read ARM's Statement ][121]
[ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids Access
to Care Act]

## Membership Benefits

Join a global community collaborating to shape the future of CGT through advocacy, networking, and
scientific engagement. Together, we have the power to advance the sector and improve patients'
lives.

Already a member? [ Login to Portal [Arrow right] ][122]
[Influence]

### Influence

Participate in forums and advisory groups that develop positions on scientific, regulatory, access,
and reimbursement policies.

[Networking]

### Networking

Engage with the community via ARM’s member portal, events, workshops, and working groups to build
strategic relationships across the CGT sector.

[Capital Formation]

### Capital Formation

Access exclusive investor relations tools and attend member-only webinars and events to strengthen
your relationship with investors.

[Exposure]

### Exposure

Elevate your visibility in the CGT community through sponsorship and networking opportunities and
member-exclusive speaking and leadership roles.

## What's Coming Up

Discover regenerative medicine conferences, events, and forums that bring the CGT community
together.

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]
[AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK]

# A Focus on...

Join the American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy to connect with a global community dedicated to
advancing genetic and cellular therapies to alleviate human disease.

[ Join ASGCT ][151] [ About Us ][152]

## Advancing Knowledge, Awareness, and Education of Cell and Gene Therapies

Discover upcoming events and opportunities to advance your knowledge, build connections, and propel
the field forward.

### Introducing the ASGCT Foundation

This charitable nonprofit is dedicated to ensuring that the life-changing potential of gene and cell
therapy reaches every patient.

[ Learn More ][153]

### GME Bootcamp

This focused, one-day bootcamp is designed to prepare the next generation of clinicians to safely
and effectively integrate cell and gene therapies into patient care.

[ Join Us August 21 ][154]

### Policy Summit

Collaborate on innovative solutions with your colleagues at this dynamic, one-day event on September
14 in Washington, D.C.

[ Details ][155]

## Detect what others miss

### The ATCC Universal Mycoplasma Detection Kit detects over 120 species with high sensitivity,
### helping you protect the integrity of your cell cultures and ensure confidence in your results.

[Learn more][10]

## Physiologically relevant PBMCs

### Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) deliver consistent, assay-ready performance to model
### responses and generate reliable data.

[Learn more][11]

## Build better, more reliable molecular diagnostic assays

### Power your assays with quantitative genomic and synthetic nucleic acids designed for accuracy,
### confidence, and reproducibility.

[Explore now][12]

## More predictive research starts with advanced models

### Leverage human‑relevant organoid models to gain deeper insights into disease biology and
### therapeutic response.

[Explore organoids][13]

## Developing best practice in cell therapy manufacturing

#### #### The amc (Advanced therapy medicinal products Manufacturing Community) was formed in
#### #### September 2010 for the emerging cell therapy industry. Whilst the UK is excellent in
#### #### scientific development of cell therapies, robust manufacturing processes, essential to
#### #### establishing industry, now need to be developed.
#### 
#### #### Our vision is that the whole ATMP Manufacturing Community is the team. Members are
#### #### encouraged to attend, speak and facilitate our meetings, as well as being proactive in our
#### #### online presence.

[Members Login][19]

### The amc aims to build a critical mass that will;
* Share non commercial information so that members can learn from the experience of others
* Develop best practice to reduce the barriers to advanced therapy manufacture
* Inform and influence regulators and suppliers through a single consistent voice representing the
  industry
* Showcase UK GMP capacity to make it easy for developers (national and international) to find a
  facility which best meets their demands

We have around **[400 members][20]** who represent advanced manufacturing facilities and processes
in academia and industry. We share ideas and discuss solutions in our bi-annual technical meetings
and our Linkedin forum.

If you are active in ATMP manufacture and would like to **[join our community][21]** we always
welcome new members.

### UK biotech financing April – June 2026

UK biotech financing reached a five-year high in Q2 2026, with total equity financing of £2.11
billion, including a record £2.05 billion in venture capital. Combined with the positive momentum
seen in Q1, the first half of 2026 has delivered private investment at all levels, from start-ups to
unicorns, plus a billion-dollar M&A, signalling a sustained recovery in fundraising and recyclable
returns for both private and public sector investors.

### UK TechBio goes mainstream

The latest BIA report, TechBio: Future-ready biology, shows that TechBio now accounts for 40% of all
UK biotech deals, securing over £2.6 billion in capital between 2020–2024. Landmark deals from
Recursion, Isomorphic Labs, and CHARM Therapeutics underscore the sector’s maturity and world-class
value. While celebrating the UK’s strong early-stage innovation, the report also highlights the
“scale-up gap” as the next strategic challenge for the sector.

Helping you feel, move, and live better - without unnecessary surgeries or medications.
Regenerative treatments designed for lasting relief, enhanced mobility, and total body wellness.

## We See Health Differently

Dr. Matt Cook is a global thought leader and innovator in [regenerative medicine][49]. With over 20
years dedicated to advancing functional and regenerative treatments, he has developed a proprietary
multimodal approach that harnesses the body's natural healing power to address complex injuries and
cellular-level regeneration. All of our practitioners have trained under his guidance, ensuring you
receive precision medicine tailored to you.

For too long, medicine has focused on treating symptoms instead of finding solutions. At BioReset
Medical, we use [advanced therapies][50] and regenerative treatments to help your body heal from the
inside out. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working to
optimize your health, we create a personalized plan that works for you—not just a one-size-fits-all
treatment.

We don’t just treat patients - we teach doctors worldwide. As leaders in [ultrasound-guided
therapies][51] and [regenerative medicine][52], we train physicians through BioReset University,
ensuring that the most effective techniques are shared across the globe.

[Dr. Matt Cook, founder of BioReset Medical.]

**What Is Regenerative Medicine & Concierge Care?

‍**Regenerative medicine uses biologic therapies - like PRP, stem cells, and peptides - to stimulate
your body’s natural healing processes. At BioReset Medical, our concierge model ensures you receive
direct access to world-class specialists, priority scheduling, and fully personalized treatment
plans.
‍

Whether you’re managing chronic pain, recovering from injury, or optimizing healthspan, our team
crafts solutions that address your unique needs - so you can reclaim your mobility, vitality, and
confidence.

**Benefits** **of Regenerative Concierge Care:

- Personalized Precision **Every treatment plan is custom-designed using advanced diagnostics and
one-on-one expert guidance.

**-** **Non-Surgical Relief **Minimally invasive therapies promote tissue regeneration and reduce
pain without the risks of surgery.

**-** **Seamless Concierge Experience **Direct access to specialists, immediate appointment
availability, and holistic support from consultation through recovery.

## Supporting progress & translation of gene & cell therapies

The aim of the British Society for Gene and Cell Therapy is to support scientific progress and
promote ethical and efficient translation of gene- and cell-based technologies from the laboratory
into the clinic.

## Become a Member

Subscribe as a BSGCT member to join our community and receive membership benefits

[Find out more][37]

## Annual Conference

Annual Conference 2026, Join us in Newcastle **15th – 17th April.**

## 2nd Cell & Gene Therapy Global Congress 2024 Europe

The Fastest Growing Cell & Gene Therapy Networking Event. 
* Introduction
* Insight
* Who Should Attend

Cell and Gene therapies are forms of personalised, regenerative medicine. Described as the most
innovative, promising and life-changing new categories of medicines whose full potential is only
just beginning to emerge. They are cutting-edge and rapidly progressing fields of Biological
Therapies. Also known as “Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products”, they involved the use of cells,
tissues and genes to treat, prevent or potentially cure and eliminate complicated health conditions
and difficult to treat diseases. These therapies promise life-changing treatments for a broad
spectrum of complex diseases ranging from genetic conditions to cancers. Both approaches offer the
potential to diminish the fundamental cause of genetic and acquired diseases by substituting the
missing protein or cells causing the disease’s symptoms. Cell and gene therapies may offer longer
lasting effects than traditional medicines. Convergence of advanced biotechnology, precision
medicine, and expertise in manufacturing has facilitated the way for these therapies to become a
reality, with remarkable successes observed in conditions such as cancer and genetic disorders.

Cell and Gene therapy has transformed the healthcare and biopharma industry by storm. Currently,
after around 40 CGT launches across the EU and US, the market is worth around EUR 4.5 billion. A
similar number are expected to be approved by 2028, when sales are projected to rise to EUR 19.2
billion. The development of biological therapies is rapidly expanding, however, commercialisation of
this treatment poses different challenges to research and development, authorisation, manufacturing,
accessibility, and ensuring safety throughout the lifecycle of the product.

The two-day Congress will provide an interactive, cutting edge, and comprehensive discussions in
collaborative format led by key experts with intimate knowledge in the industry. Gain practical
strategies and best practices on challenges, innovations, technologies, and concepts to help you
gain access to the booming CGT market.

We are putting together an agenda that focuses on “driving innovation, addressing significant unmet
medical needs, and ultimately improving patient outcomes”.

We are gathering high calibre expert speakers to participate and share their knowledge and expertise
through Keynote Presentations and Panel discussions, addressing all aspects of the industry.

We look forward to welcoming you to the **CGT World Congress 2024!**

Sincerely yours,
Jocelyn Raguindin
Conference Director

# TALEN^{®} for Best-In-Class Gene Editing

Cellectis leverages its leadership in gene editing through its flagship technology, TALEN^{®}, which
allows the company to create CAR T therapies to **bring new hope to cancer patients through broadly
available, off-the-shelf therapies**. TALEN^{®} has been successfully used in the clinic to solve
key challenges with allogeneic CAR T including protection from Graft vs. Host Disease, mitigation of
rejection and enhanced safety via the integration of a suicide switch.

[Learn more][36]

"Off-the-shelf" immunotherapies
that can work for the largest number of patients

Cellectis gene-edits “Chimeric Antigen Receptor” (CAR) T-cells from healthy donors into
“off-the-shelf” immunotherapy product candidates that are designed to work for the largest number of
patients. It’s the difference between being an off-the-shelf product and a service in which each
treatment has to be custom-made. This same technology, developed by Cellectis, could help in
designing therapies for many other diseases.

[Learn more][37]

Strong intellectual property,
global strategic partnerships.

25 years of innovation. more than 100 patent families. 300 granted patents and 200 applications.
Global strategic partnerships with Allogene, Servier, Iovance, Primera and AstraZeneca

* ***Efficacy:**** ORR of 68% with lasme-cel Process 2 (n=22), 83% at RP2D (n=12) and 100% in the
  target Phase 2 population (n=9)*

 
* ***Safety: ****in Phase 1 (n=40), lasme-cel was generally well-tolerated (including 1 case of
  grade 2 IEC-HS which resolved)*

 
* ***Durability: ****in patients who achieved MRD-negative CR/CRi, median OS was 14.8 months*

 
* *In the target Phase 2 population, CR/CRi rate of 56% with ~80% of patients achieving MRD-negative
  status*

# TALEN^{®} for Best-In-Class Gene Editing

Cellectis leverages its leadership in gene editing through its flagship technology, TALEN^{®}, which
allows the company to create CAR T therapies to **bring new hope to cancer patients through broadly
available, off-the-shelf therapies**. TALEN^{®} has been successfully used in the clinic to solve
key challenges with allogeneic CAR T including protection from Graft vs. Host Disease, mitigation of
rejection and enhanced safety via the integration of a suicide switch.

[Learn more][36]

"Off-the-shelf" immunotherapies
that can work for the largest number of patients

Cellectis gene-edits “Chimeric Antigen Receptor” (CAR) T-cells from healthy donors into
“off-the-shelf” immunotherapy product candidates that are designed to work for the largest number of
patients. It’s the difference between being an off-the-shelf product and a service in which each
treatment has to be custom-made. This same technology, developed by Cellectis, could help in
designing therapies for many other diseases.

[Learn more][37]

# The future of cell therapy manufacturing is automated.

[ Book an in-person visit ][8] [ Explore a facility in 3D ][9]

## Constellation® is the automated cell therapy manufacturing platform for flexible scale-up.

The next generation of cell therapies need a new manufacturing model. Constellation is a fully
automated robotic platform enabling flexible, low-risk manufacturing expansion for autologous and
allogeneic cell therapies.

[image alt text ]

### End-to-end production.

Highest operational efficiency. Lowest cost-per-dose. 

[image alt text ]

### Facility
### flexibility.

Add capacity incrementally. Adapt layouts as needs evolve.

[image alt text ]

### Payback in
### <1 year.

ROI delivered in ~11 months.

[image alt text ]

### GMP instruments.

Integration with your validated instruments and consumables.

[Why Constellation®?][10]

## A new standard for scale-up.

What makes Constellation unique is that the system scales by adding capacity to specific
manufacturing steps, rather than unnecessarily duplicating entire blocks. Modular workstations and
mobile robots enable flexible expansion, higher facility utilisation, and a manufacturing system
that grows with you.



### Modular workstations

The chosen facility is configured with workstations for each manufacturing unit operation, in the
right ratio for maximum utilisation. Workstations contain validated GMP instruments.



### Mobile robots

Instead of people moving materials, mobile robots transport consumables and cell material between
workstations and execute every step precisely in sequence. A small team of operators supervise and
input materials.



### Sterile fluid transfer

Cell materials remain in a closed system throughout, with FDA-approved tube welding creating sealed
fluid connections between every unit operation.



### Total digital integration

Overseeing all of this is a single software layer that orchestrates the workflow, tracks every
action, and generates complete digital batch records of cell therapy manufacturing.

[Discover the technology][11]

## The biology you've perfected, at the scale you need.

[Constellation ][12]is designed to transform labour-intensive cell therapy production into a
coordinated, scalable operation. The platform integrates seamlessly with your existing biology,
process and supply chain, using validated GMP instruments and consumables.

Constellation can be deployed in your facility, or we work with selected CDMO partners to provide a
wholly outsourced manufacturing solution.

[cell therapy industrialisation]

## Powered by partnership.

We work side-by-side with industry-leading technology providers to integrate GMP instruments and
consumables - such as the Sefia Select™, Cue® and G-Rex® - into one coordinated platform. This
ensures automation preserves the biological performance therapy developers have achieved.

Together, we are creating the infrastructure needed to make commercial cell therapy manufacturing
viable at global scale.

[Our instrument partners][13]

## Return on investment in less than 12 months.

Constellation is a capital investment that pays for itself quickly by establishing efficient
manufacturing operations from day one. Independent modelling by PM Group, presented at Interphex
2025, shows that Constellation delivers packback in around 11 months.

This graph compares the estimated annual operating costs (OPEX) of different cell therapy
manufacturing approaches.

# DSI IS THE LEADER IN REGULATORY DRUG DEVELOPMENT

## ARE YOU DEVELOPING PRODUCTS WITH THE INTENTION OF MARKETING, LICENSING, OR DIVESTING?

DSI provides regulatory, technical, and project management consulting services to healthcare product
companies that manufacture and/or market pharmaceuticals, biopharmaceuticals, animal health, and
cellular and gene therapy products.

Since 2007 we have provided our clients with innovative strategies and exceptional quality work
products intended to enhance product development, approval, and marketing presence.

Whether advocating CMC strategy, directing CMC operations or developing CMC submission content that
represent the best interests of emerging biotech, we focus on the critical CMC issues and build
programs that enhance development.

### WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM DSI?

All the expertise you need under one roof

There is no need to hire multiple consultants. DSI has all the expertise you need to advance your
product development and regulatory approval programs.

Breadth of experience

DSI helps clients develop many types of regulated products. We have worked with companies to develop
and obtain marketing clearance for drugs, and biologics in many therapeutic areas, including
oncology, cardiovascular disease, metabolic disorders, and neurology.

Flexibility and responsiveness

We understand our client’s need to reach company goals quickly. We are there when you need us and
can provide a quick answer to a question or full product development support.

Deep knowledge of regulatory expectations

Our understanding of regulatory expectations comes from knowledge gained from experiences with other
clients, products, and regulatory agency interactions.

Professional, experienced consultants

DSI’s staff includes technical, and regulatory professionals, most with more than 15 years of
experience in product development and marketed product support. DSI’s consultants have worked with
FDA regulators in CMO’s and pharmaceutical and emerging biotech companies.

# DSI IS THE LEADER IN REGULATORY DRUG DEVELOPMENT

## ARE YOU DEVELOPING PRODUCTS WITH THE INTENTION OF MARKETING, LICENSING, OR DIVESTING?

DSI provides regulatory, technical, and project management consulting services to healthcare product
companies that manufacture and/or market pharmaceuticals, biopharmaceuticals, animal health, and
cellular and gene therapy products.

Since 2007 we have provided our clients with innovative strategies and exceptional quality work
products intended to enhance product development, approval, and marketing presence.

Whether advocating CMC strategy, directing CMC operations or developing CMC submission content that
represent the best interests of emerging biotech, we focus on the critical CMC issues and build
programs that enhance development.

### WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM DSI?

All the expertise you need under one roof

There is no need to hire multiple consultants. DSI has all the expertise you need to advance your
product development and regulatory approval programs.

Breadth of experience

DSI helps clients develop many types of regulated products. We have worked with companies to develop
and obtain marketing clearance for drugs, and biologics in many therapeutic areas, including
oncology, cardiovascular disease, metabolic disorders, and neurology.

Flexibility and responsiveness

We understand our client’s need to reach company goals quickly. We are there when you need us and
can provide a quick answer to a question or full product development support.

Deep knowledge of regulatory expectations

Our understanding of regulatory expectations comes from knowledge gained from experiences with other
clients, products, and regulatory agency interactions.

Professional, experienced consultants

DSI’s staff includes technical, and regulatory professionals, most with more than 15 years of
experience in product development and marketed product support. DSI’s consultants have worked with
FDA regulators in CMO’s and pharmaceutical and emerging biotech companies.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

# Where Consultancy Leads and GMP Delivers. Your Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

eXmoor Pharma is the only integrated CGT CDMO with over 20 years of consultancy expertise embedded
across every stage of your CMC journey — from early-phase strategy to process development, GMP
manufacturing and commercialisation.

Explore Our Services ][37]

Why eXmoor Pharma?

## Your End-to-End Cell & Gene Therapy Partner

For over 20 years, eXmoor Pharma has been at the forefront of cell and gene therapy, supporting
biotech innovators from early-phase development to full-scale GMP manufacturing. Our unique blend of
consultancy and CDMO expertise means we don’t just manufacture—we provide strategic guidance to
ensure therapies are commercially viable from day one.

We combine CMC consultancy, process development, analytical services and GMP manufacturing to
provide comprehensive support across Viral Vectors, Autologous and Allogeneic Cell Therapies, and
RNA technologies. This integrated model enables seamless progression from early-phase strategy
through to commercial readiness.

With a 70% repeat business rate and 190+ clients worldwide, we are more than a service provider—we
are your long-term partner in success.

# The Human Gene Database

GeneCards is a searchable, integrative database that provides comprehensive, user-friendly
information on all annotated and predicted human genes. The knowledgebase automatically integrates
gene-centric data from 193 web sources, including genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic,
clinical and functional information.

Comprehensive integrated information on all annotated human genes from 193 sources.

e.g.
* NFE2L2
* MALAT1
* prostate cancer

#                                   Gene & Cell Ltd

#### A London-based, Globally-operating, Consulting Firm for the Gene & Cell Therapies

#### CGT Consultancy

Consultancy services for cell and gene therapies (CGT) play a crucial role in navigating the
complexities of developing and bringing these advanced therapies to market. By leveraging the
expertise of our specialized consultants/collaborators and contractors, companies can enhance their
R&D efforts, ensure regulatory compliance, optimize clinical development, and develop effective
commercial strategies.

Our consultancy services for cell and gene therapies are specialized services aimed at supporting
companies, research institutions, and healthcare providers in the development, regulatory approval,
and commercialization of cell and gene therapies. These services cover a wide range of activities,
including scientific and technical support, regulatory guidance, market analysis, and strategic
consulting.

#### Benefits of our CGT Consulting Services

Expertise: Access to specialized knowledge and experience in a highly complex field.

Efficiency: Streamlined processes and reduced time to market.

Compliance: Ensuring adherence to regulatory standards, minimizing risks of delays or non-approvals.

Innovation: Support for innovative approaches and technologies to stay competitive in the market.

Cost-Effectiveness: Optimizing resources and reducing costs through strategic planning and expert
guidance.



Pricing for cell and gene therapy consultancy can vary widely based on several factors such as the
expertise of the consultant, the scope and complexity of the project, the duration of the
consultancy, and the specific services required.  We are a small, specialized firm focusing solely
on the CGT field and we offer competitive rates with deep industry expertise. We offer highly
competitive hourly rates, project-based rates, retainer agreement fees and specialised services
using specialised expert collaborators/contractors.



Why don't you try us:

The 1st hr of our CGT Consultancy is free! We can learn more about what you need, you can learn more
about what we offer and we could discuss the requirements of your project under either a
confidential (CDA) or a non-confidential framework.

#### Gene & Cell Ltd: CEO & Founder

## Takis Athanasopoulos

Dr Takis Athanasopoulos is currently the CEO & Founder of Gene & Cell Ltd. a Gene & Cell Therapy
Consulting Firm, based in London. He has more than 25 years of expertise in the field of CGT. He has
offered advice/offer consultation in CGT program deliverables and activities to various
companies/start-ups/Biotechs (e.g. ViGeneron, TheraCell, Orgenesis, Octomera, Asgard Tx, Complement
Tx, Genethon, Quethera), Consulting Firms (Dark Horse Consulting Group) & VC Partners (Sofinova). He
was previously appointed as VP of Gene Therapy Research & Vector Technology, at Vigeneron GmBH,
Munich, Germany. Prior to joining ViGeneron, Takis has previously held leadership positions at GSK,
acting as Director & Head of various functional CGT GSK units i.e.Vector Innovation/Vector
Development, Patient Operations, Transgene Delivery and Vector & Transgene Units, as part of Cell &
Gene Therapy (CGT), Medicinal Science & Technology (MST) platform of GSK at Stevenage, UK. Before
joining GSK, Takis was a Lecturer in Molecular Biotechnology at University of Wolverhampton and
Academic Visitor/Research Consultant for the Gene Therapy Group at Royal Holloway University of
London (RHUL). Before joining the Faculty of Science and Engineering at UoW, Takis has been a member
of the Collaboration for AIDS Vaccine Discovery (CAVD)-an international network of scientists and
experts dedicated to designing a variety of novel HIV vaccine candidates and advancing the most
promising ones to clinical trials. He holds a BSc in Biochemistry from University of Patras, Greece,
and a PhD in Biomedical Sciences from the University of London.

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

# Home

# ISCT has a vision to translate cell & gene therapies into safe and effective treatments to improve
# patients' lives.

## Thank You FOR JOINING US IN Dublin!

Highlights from ISCT 2026

With packed sessions, global expert speakers, and undeniable enthusiasm across our delegates, it has
been a truly memorable meeting in Dublin. The strength of ISCT is our community - our members,
presenters, delegates, partners, and corporate supporters. We offer our warmest thanks, as together,
we continue to advance the Golden Age of Cell and Gene Therapy.
"...In my opinion, the best conference, and the greatest community."
- Dominic Clarke, PhD, ISCT 2026 Roundtable Co-Chair
With packed sessions, global expert speakers, and undeniable enthusiasm across our delegates, it was
a memorable start to our Dublin meeting.
Day 1 Recap →
"...Once you come to one meeting, you're gonna be hooked. You're gonna come back every year."
- Edwin Horwitz, MD, PhD, Editor-in-Chief of Cytotherapy®
Day Two of ISCT 2026 saw high-energy networking events, strong energy across exhibit and poster
halls, and a truly global selection of high-quality scientific content.
Day 2 Recap →
"We've moved, as an organization, from 'How do we manufacture these products?' to 'How do we get
them in the hands of more patients?'"
- Mark Flower, BSc, ISCT North America Regional Treasurer
Though we wrapped our time in Dublin, the stage is set for our global community to continue driving
momentum across the full translational chain.
Day 3 Recap →

# GMP Manufacturing Services For Clinical Trials

Services offered by the facilities include:
* The aseptic manufacturing of large and small volume liquids
* The non-sterile manufacturing of a range of dosage forms
* Ambient, refrigerated and frozen storage
* Label design (adheres to Annex 13), printing and application
* Primary and secondary packaging, including blinding of IMP
* Fully trained staff
* Distribution to clinical trial sites
* GMP QC
* Product certification and release by a QP
* Current EU GMP standards
* Home Office licence to order, store supply and possess as part of a clinical trial
* MHRA MIA (IMP) licence

###### PHARMACEUTICAL EXCELLENCE

### DELIVERING FOR YOU

### ABOUT US

## The GMP Manufacturing Facility For Clinical Trials

MAC focuses on manufacturing medications for Phase 1 through phase 3 studies. We support both
independent research centres and the NHS in conducting clinical trials. MAC Clinical Research is the
UK's largest neuroscience research company dedicated to the recruitment and management of clinical
trials. MAC currently has eight dedicated research centres across the UK conducting trials from
complex early phase all the way to Phase IV studies for a wide range of therapeutic areas.

[Read More][13]

## 事業内容
## BUSINESS

### 特定細胞加工物製造業

再生医療等安全性確保法に基づく特定細胞加工物の製造を受託します。

[詳しく見る][85]

### CDMO事業

医薬品医療機器等法（薬機法）に基づく再生医療等製品・治験製品の工程開発から製造受託までトータルサポー
トで承ります。

[詳しく見る][86]

### バリューチェーン事業

再生医療の細胞加工に携わるすべてのお客様の業務負荷を軽減するためのソリューションを提供し、円滑な再生
医療の実施を支援いたします。

[詳しく見る][87]

### 自己がん組織バンク

将来のがん治療に備えて、がんの手術などで摘出した患者さんのがん組織を無償でお預かりします。

[詳しく見る][88]

### 免疫細胞治療とは

免疫細胞治療は、自分の免疫細胞を使ってがんを攻撃する治療法です。メディネットは創業以来、免疫細胞治療
の技術開発に取り組んでいます。

[詳しく見る][89]

[詳しく見る][88]

の技術開発に取り組んでいます。

# Manufacturing Excellence for Transformative Therapies

## Your Lifelong Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

[ Explore Our Services ][68]

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

[ Request A Consult ][69]
[commercial-capacity-logo]
Early development to commercial capacity
[flex-scalable-updated]
Flexible, scalable technology solutions
[ai-manufacturing-icon]
AI-enabled development and GMP manufacturing

## Seamless Transition from Early Development to Commercial Supply

Our expertise in advanced manufacturing services ensures the reliable execution needed to propel
your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

## Advancing Autologous Cell Therapies with Robust, Scalable Solutions

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate
closed-unit systems, AI models, and robotics to create robust, scalable, and efficient processes
tailored to your needs.

#### Process Development

Process development and optimization expertise for enhanced robustness and reliable scale-up.
[ Explore Process Development ][70]

#### Analytical Development

Comprehensive analytical development services for tailored and established assays.
[ EXPLORE ANALYTICAL DEVELOPMENT ][71]

#### Autologous Manufacturing

Hamilton Intelligent Facility: AI and robotics integration for enhanced production rates and reduced
costs.
[ EXPLORE AUTOLOGOUS MANUFACTURING ][72]

#### Platform Expertise

Cutting-edge cell platforms for lentiviral vector-, immune cell- and iPSC-based therapies.
[ EXPLORE OUR PLATFORMS ][73]

#### GMP Manufacturing

Resilient manufacturing for consistent quality, certified compliance, and minimal risks at every
stage.
[ EXPLORE GMP MANUFACTURING ][74]

#### Commercial Manufacturing

Efficient scalability, timely QC release, and reliable delivery to support your commercial goals.
[ EXPLORE COMMERCIAL MANUFACTURING ][75]

# Manufacturing Excellence for Transformative Therapies

## Your Lifelong Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

## Seamless Transition from Early Development to Commercial Supply

Our expertise in advanced manufacturing services ensures the reliable execution needed to propel
your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

## Advancing Autologous Cell Therapies with Robust, Scalable Solutions

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate
closed-unit systems, AI models, and robotics to create robust, scalable, and efficient processes
tailored to your needs.

Process development and optimization expertise for enhanced robustness and reliable scale-up.

## Have a Question?


### Who are Phacilitate?

Phacilitate is a global platform serving the advanced therapies industry through events, content,
research, networking and industry intelligence. We connect the people responsible for developing,
manufacturing, funding, regulating and commercialising cell and gene therapies.

### What industries does Phacilitate serve?

Phacilitate serves professionals across the advanced therapies ecosystem, including biotechnology
companies, pharmaceutical organisations, investors, academics, regulators, healthcare providers,
manufacturers, technology providers and patient-focused organisations.

### What topics in gene therapy are covered at these events?

Across all three events, gene therapy is a core focus. Sessions span clinical trials, molecular
therapy innovations, CRISPR-based therapy, CAR T therapy, and the evolving regulatory landscape for
gene therapies. You’ll also explore key themes such as patient access, platform scalability, and
approaches to gene therapy research.

### Where and when are the upcoming events?

[Advanced Therapies Europe][28] - September 7-9, 2026 in Barcelona, Spain 

[Advanced Therapies World][29] - December 5-6, 2026 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia 

[Advanced Therapies Week][30] - January 18-21, 2027 in San Diego, USA 

### Who will I meet if I attend?

You’ll connect with global leaders across the cell and gene therapy ecosystem, including therapeutic
developers, regulators, investors, CROs, CDMOs, academics, and patient advocates. Whether you’re
seeking strategic partnerships or clinical collaborators, these events bring the right people
together.

recent gene therapy approvals or are breaking ground in next-gen platforms and clinical

# DON’T DIE

Humanity’s plan as we evolve from Homo Sapiens to Homo Evolutis.

## **Bryan’s Protocol**

Hi friends,

We might be the first generation that doesn’t die. To that end, my team and I have spent the last
few years building the world’s first Don’t Die protocol. 

Some of you don’t care about Don’t Die, you just want to be hot. That’s cool too. It’s really the
same thing.

To make this Don’t Die thing understandable, I’ve made it into a game because humans love games.
You’ll learn how to flex your biomarkers with friends. You’ll be able to share the science with
friends on why poor sleep is a terrible idea.

Personally, I have kind of taken this whole thing to the extreme. There’s the world’s fastest
person, and the richest, but never before has there been the “Healthiest Person in the World.” 

I’ve tried to become that person. I am certainly the most biologically measured person ever. 

Online, people refer to me as “immortal unc.” That’s what we care about. We are family and we care
about your well-being. In fact, I want to be the strongest voice in your mind encouraging you to
make health your top life priority.

To remind you that you will be a better father, mother, brother, sister, friend, colleague, and
human when you do so.

If you’re new to this game of health, don’t worry. I made disastrous health decisions in life until
I was 42 and my body has bounced back. No matter your situation, you can too.

Below I’m going to share everything my team and I have learned over the past few years, spending
millions of dollars researching, experimenting and measuring. We’ve made the mistakes for you.

Know that we are also hard at work to make all of this easier, more accessible and fun.

We are living in the most exciting time in human history. The future is probably cooler than
anything we can imagine. Our goal is to get there, together. 

Don’t Die,Bryan Johnson
Planet Earth, 2026

When I [started Project Blueprint][43], I was a broken down 42 year old. Sugar cereal and soda as a

hurt, and I was losing my hair.

I share this to give you hope that you can meaningfully change your health for the better. There are
of course limitations with today’s science, but more can be accomplished than most people think.

batch sizes for both domestic and export markets.

manufacturing capabilities.

You can reach us via the Contact Us page, or call +91 98911 66686 / +91 98112 25580, or email

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

## Fully Configurable for Fit-For-Purpose Use

Our uniquely combined clinical research technology and consulting services help clients to design,
operate, and scale next-generation research studies and electronic clinical outcome assessment
(eCOA) programs for participants, sites, and study teams.

### Measure What Matters Most

Grounded in the patient experience, we design meaningful outcome measures to optimize
decision-making about the development, commercialization and use of medical products.

[Learn More About Patient-Centered Outcomes →][10]
[Concepts and measurement diagram for clinical endpoint selection]
[THREAD patient listening experience shown on mobile and desktop]

### Listening to the Voice of the Patient and HCPs

Study sponsors and CROs understand the vital importance of listening to patients and caregivers
throughout the drug development lifecycle. inVibe has solved those challenges with a methodology and
technology to collect and analyze real patient voices that are simple, systematic, and scalable
across the organization.

[Patient Listening for Clinical Research →][11]

### Next Generation of Research for Everyone, Everywhere

THREAD delivers one of the most trusted, patient-centric, comprehensive and advanced technologies in
the industry. Our technology was built from the ground up to meet the needs of modern clinical
trials — whether they be site-based, fully decentralized clinical trials (DCTs), or hybrid studies.

[Discover the THREAD Platform →][12]

everywhere. The company’s uniquely combined clinical research technology and consulting services
help life science organizations to design, operate, and scale next-generation research studies and
electronic clinical outcome assessments (eCOA) programs for participants, sites, and study teams.
Through its comprehensive platform and scientific expertise, THREAD empowers studies to be
accessible, efficient, and centered on the patient.

Walter® Healthcare is one of India’s leading pharmaceutical CDMO / CMO. Backed by personnel with
over 25 years of expertise in the pharmaceutical industry, Walter's strategic business areas spread
across generics, APIs, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, custom pharmaceutical services, and branded
generics. The company is widely recognised for its strengths in manufacturing turn-around-time,
efficacy, service, and, new product additions, explorations in new therapeutic arenas, and
commercialisation of a wide range of products. Pharma Manufacturer, Pharma Company, Pharma PCD


Walter has 5 state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities strategically structured nationwide, approved
by stringent global regulatory authorities. Our own-brands portfolio includes 800 plus products
encompassing major therapeutic categories such as Cardiovascular, Neurology, Psychiatric, Hepatitis,
Gastroenterology, Respiratory & COPD, Rheumatology, Nephrology, Urology, Diabetes, Hepatology, and
Immunology, etc.


We’re not just another factory. We’re a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO)
built for speed, compliance, and scale. From oral solids and liquids to injectables and
nutraceuticals, we offer full-spectrum pharmaceutical manufacturing under one roof — backed by
GLP-certified labs, end-to-end quality systems, and audit-ready infrastructure.

 

Whether you’re a startup brand, a scaling MSME, or a public-listed pharma company looking for a
reliable CMO, Walter® is engineered to be your backend execution partner — not just a vendor.

 

 

## 🛠️ What We Offer

* WHO-GMP Certified Manufacturing Units
  
  For tablets, capsules, syrups, ointments, sachets, and injectables — fully licensed and
  export-compliant.
* GLP-Compliant In-House Laboratory (LabTrust™)
  
  Complete testing capabilities: ICH stability, endotoxins, microbial limits, preservative efficacy,
  and more.
* Aseptic Injectable & Nutraceutical Divisions
  
  With lyophilization, cleanroom tech, and specialized manufacturing lines — ensuring safety,
  sterility, and scalability.
* Walter® PlantSure™ Framework
  
  Our in-house quality philosophy that ensures every batch meets not just compliance, but
  consistency.
* 130,000+ sq. ft. Across 3 Facilities in Punjab & Himachal
  
  Built to handle high-volume demand with low MOQs, high agility, and 24/7 audit readiness.
* Turnkey Manufacturing Support
  
  Including formulation, packaging, licensing, testing, documentation, and dispatch — all under one
  point of contact.

 

 

## 🌐 Who We Work With

 
* Generic Pharma Companies (India & Emerging Markets)
* Public-Listed Mid-Sized Pharma Brands
* Distributors & Exporters (Semi-Regulated/Unregulated Countries)
* Nutraceutical, Ayurvedic & D2C Healthcare Brands
* Government Supply Tenders (upon request)

 

 

## 🤝 Why Choose Walter®

 
* Low MOQs, fast turnarounds
* Radical transparency and accountability
* No overpromises — just high-performance execution
* Real photos, real infrastructure, real compliance

If you are faced with choosing between multiple distributors representing many of the same top
manufacturers, then as both a consumer and a clinician, you should have two basic questions. First,

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Here are some great questions you have on your mind!

Does a distributor need to be registered with the state of NJ to sell medical devices there?

Yes. [NJAC 8:21-3A][22] is the applicable statute. You can verify a distribution
business [here][23]. Our registration number is 5005403.

Does my practice require a blood bank license to prepare PRP?

Yes. Under the provisions of [NJSA 26:2A][24] you will be required to obtain a blood bank license
for perioperative autologous blood collection/administration. It is a fairly easy process and we are
happy to help guide you through this.

Please call us at [609-975-9884][25] or send an e-mail to [info@5linemed.com][26] to request more
information.

[[5 line Biologics logo][5 line Biologics logo]][27]

We provide full in-service product support. We also offer one-on-one training conducted through
partner physicians experienced with these types of procedures. We will provide this training in your
office.

## Explore Our Products
* [
  Primary Cells
  
  Primary cells are isolated from fresh tissues, which can maintain the basic properties of the
  original cells. Therefore, as an in vitro experimental model, primary cells are widely used in
  basic research of molecular, cell biology and biomedicine, such as proteomics, genomics and
  genetics, and also in drug screening, drug metabolism and toxicology, cancer drug research, etc.
  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.

### Culturing Innovative Partnerships

###### ADVENT BIOSERVICES


###### CONTRACT DEVELOPMENT & MANUFACTURING ORGANISATION (CDMO)

#### Your ideal partner in cell therapy

Advent Bioservices began activity as a cell therapy Contract Development & Manufacturing
Organisation (CDMO) in 2016. We are currently managing the development of a state-of-the-art
facility for multiproduct Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) production outside Sawston in
Cambridgeshire, which will allow scale up of current commercial production and initiate the
provision of contract manufacturing services to meet the growing demand for such services in the
UK. 

 

The Sawston facility is perfectly positioned in the ‘UK golden triangle’ for cell and gene therapy,
our facility is located just 7 miles outside Cambridge city centre with excellent transport links to
Central London, London Stansted airport and it is 4 miles from the M11 motorway, linking to the
Midlands by the new A14 extension.

 

The facility consists of 2 separate GMP suites with grade B/C classified areas, in house QC testing,
process development laboratories, warehouse and office space as well as a multipurpose cold storage
and cryogenic storage unit. 

 

We operate the facility under a comprehensive IT infrastructure including EMS,  eQMS eBMR and LIMS
systems with secure storage for client documents and paperless systems. Our cleanroom suites are
fully validated, with an in-house environmental monitoring system. Clients utilising our
manufacturing service will benefit from ancillary services and technical support inclusive of
process development, QC and validation. Ultra-cold and cryogenic facilities are available to
external clients as off-site storage and are fully GMP compliant.

.

About Us
Why Choose Us?

## Why Choose Us?

Important values we share with our partners...

[Scalability.png]

#### SCALABILITY

We can help you solve your scale up difficulties and can support your expansion across multiple
areas including research and development,  process development, higher volume manufacturing and
meeting regulatory standards.

[Boundaries.png]

#### EXPANDED

#### POTENTIAL

We can develop to meet your need, wherever they are. With our global mindset, Advent Bioservices can
break down borders ensuring the best possible outcome at every stage of your journey.

[Benchmarks.png]

#### REGULATORY COMPLIANCE

We operate to the highest industry standards with expertise in regulatory standards including HTA,
MHRA and JACIE. We are GMP and GLP compliant and strive to reach the best quality output. We are
here to help you ensure that your process complies with relevant standards.

[HumanTouch.png]

#### THE PERSONAL TOUCH

The Advent Bioservices team is conscientious, professional and easy to communicate with. We nurture
our business with respect for our clients needs. We have a happy and healthy business culture.

[Discovery.png]

#### DISCOVERY

Research and development plays a vital part in the advancement of the growth of the cell and gene
therapies industry. We can help you by focusing on innovation and optimisation, attending to your
individual requirements.

[HealthPartners.png]

#### CULTURING PARTNERSHIPS

In the complex biosciences industry, having people that you trust is essential. Our priorities are
focused on building long-term partnerships and supporting our clients.

## Some positive words

#### “Coming to work knowing we are contributing to improving another person’s quality of life is
#### unbelievably rewarding. On top of that coming to a company who offer tremendous opportunities
#### for both professional and personal development is just wonderful”

- Alia Klyn. Production Scientist.

Services & Facilites

## Services & Facilities

The UK cell and gene therapy industry is expanding at a rapid rate. In the last 5 years, cleanroom
space increased annually to a current total of 7819 sq m and the UK initiated 112 new ATMP clinical
trials - the highest number for all European countries. This has resulted in strong demand for GMP
manufacturing services, expertise in commercialisation and scale up of manufacture.

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

# A Focus on...

Join the American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy to connect with a global community dedicated to
advancing genetic and cellular therapies to alleviate human disease.

[ Join ASGCT ][151] [ About Us ][152]

## Advancing Knowledge, Awareness, and Education of Cell and Gene Therapies

Discover upcoming events and opportunities to advance your knowledge, build connections, and propel
the field forward.

### Introducing the ASGCT Foundation

This charitable nonprofit is dedicated to ensuring that the life-changing potential of gene and cell
therapy reaches every patient.

[ Learn More ][153]

### GME Bootcamp

This focused, one-day bootcamp is designed to prepare the next generation of clinicians to safely
and effectively integrate cell and gene therapies into patient care.

[ Join Us August 21 ][154]

### Policy Summit

Collaborate on innovative solutions with your colleagues at this dynamic, one-day event on September
14 in Washington, D.C.

[ Details ][155]

## Detect what others miss

### The ATCC Universal Mycoplasma Detection Kit detects over 120 species with high sensitivity,
### helping you protect the integrity of your cell cultures and ensure confidence in your results.

[Learn more][10]

## Physiologically relevant PBMCs

### Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) deliver consistent, assay-ready performance to model
### responses and generate reliable data.

[Learn more][11]

## Build better, more reliable molecular diagnostic assays

### Power your assays with quantitative genomic and synthetic nucleic acids designed for accuracy,
### confidence, and reproducibility.

[Explore now][12]

## More predictive research starts with advanced models

### Leverage human‑relevant organoid models to gain deeper insights into disease biology and
### therapeutic response.

[Explore organoids][13]

 

[ [Fluorescent blue and green spheres of leukemic cells.] ][14]

### Oncology and immuno-oncology

Discover advanced biological models and patient-derived cell lines that can help you transform the
cancer treatment landscape.

[Discover now][15]

Streamline your toxicological studies by incorporating credible models that support every phase of
your research and testing process.

[Streamline your studies][17]

### Molecular diagnostics development

Develop and validate your molecular diagnostic assays faster with relevant, ready-to-use reference
materials.

[Find assay development tools][19]

Combine the power of physical standards with authenticated whole-genome and whole-transcriptome
data.

[Explore now][21]

### Bioproduction

Discover credible resources for industrial bioprocessing, vaccine development, antibody production,
and protein expression.

[Find resources][23]

Support your testing and assay development needs with high-quality reference materials and national
consensus standards from ATCC.

## Developing best practice in cell therapy manufacturing

#### #### The amc (Advanced therapy medicinal products Manufacturing Community) was formed in
#### #### September 2010 for the emerging cell therapy industry. Whilst the UK is excellent in
#### #### scientific development of cell therapies, robust manufacturing processes, essential to
#### #### establishing industry, now need to be developed.
#### 
#### #### Our vision is that the whole ATMP Manufacturing Community is the team. Members are
#### #### encouraged to attend, speak and facilitate our meetings, as well as being proactive in our
#### #### online presence.

[Members Login][19]

### The amc aims to build a critical mass that will;
* Share non commercial information so that members can learn from the experience of others
* Develop best practice to reduce the barriers to advanced therapy manufacture
* Inform and influence regulators and suppliers through a single consistent voice representing the
  industry
* Showcase UK GMP capacity to make it easy for developers (national and international) to find a
  facility which best meets their demands

We have around **[400 members][20]** who represent advanced manufacturing facilities and processes
in academia and industry. We share ideas and discuss solutions in our bi-annual technical meetings
and our Linkedin forum.

If you are active in ATMP manufacture and would like to **[join our community][21]** we always
welcome new members.

### UK biotech financing April – June 2026

UK biotech financing reached a five-year high in Q2 2026, with total equity financing of £2.11
billion, including a record £2.05 billion in venture capital. Combined with the positive momentum
seen in Q1, the first half of 2026 has delivered private investment at all levels, from start-ups to
unicorns, plus a billion-dollar M&A, signalling a sustained recovery in fundraising and recyclable
returns for both private and public sector investors.

### UK TechBio goes mainstream

The latest BIA report, TechBio: Future-ready biology, shows that TechBio now accounts for 40% of all
UK biotech deals, securing over £2.6 billion in capital between 2020–2024. Landmark deals from
Recursion, Isomorphic Labs, and CHARM Therapeutics underscore the sector’s maturity and world-class
value. While celebrating the UK’s strong early-stage innovation, the report also highlights the
“scale-up gap” as the next strategic challenge for the sector.

Helping you feel, move, and live better - without unnecessary surgeries or medications.
Regenerative treatments designed for lasting relief, enhanced mobility, and total body wellness.

## We See Health Differently

Dr. Matt Cook is a global thought leader and innovator in [regenerative medicine][49]. With over 20
years dedicated to advancing functional and regenerative treatments, he has developed a proprietary
multimodal approach that harnesses the body's natural healing power to address complex injuries and
cellular-level regeneration. All of our practitioners have trained under his guidance, ensuring you
receive precision medicine tailored to you.

For too long, medicine has focused on treating symptoms instead of finding solutions. At BioReset
Medical, we use [advanced therapies][50] and regenerative treatments to help your body heal from the
inside out. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working to
optimize your health, we create a personalized plan that works for you—not just a one-size-fits-all
treatment.

We don’t just treat patients - we teach doctors worldwide. As leaders in [ultrasound-guided
therapies][51] and [regenerative medicine][52], we train physicians through BioReset University,
ensuring that the most effective techniques are shared across the globe.

[Dr. Matt Cook, founder of BioReset Medical.]

**What Is Regenerative Medicine & Concierge Care?

‍**Regenerative medicine uses biologic therapies - like PRP, stem cells, and peptides - to stimulate
your body’s natural healing processes. At BioReset Medical, our concierge model ensures you receive
direct access to world-class specialists, priority scheduling, and fully personalized treatment
plans.
‍

Whether you’re managing chronic pain, recovering from injury, or optimizing healthspan, our team
crafts solutions that address your unique needs - so you can reclaim your mobility, vitality, and
confidence.

**Benefits** **of Regenerative Concierge Care:

- Personalized Precision **Every treatment plan is custom-designed using advanced diagnostics and
one-on-one expert guidance.

**-** **Non-Surgical Relief **Minimally invasive therapies promote tissue regeneration and reduce
pain without the risks of surgery.

**-** **Seamless Concierge Experience **Direct access to specialists, immediate appointment
availability, and holistic support from consultation through recovery.

# Introducing the Current and New Members of the BSGCT Board

We are delighted to introduce the current and newly appointed members of the BSGCT Board. We are
grateful to our existing Board members for their continued commitment and warmly welcome the new
members joining us as we work together to advance the field of gene and cell therapy.

[Vote Now][40]
[BSGCT Board]

The British Society for Gene and Cell Therapy (BSGCT) serves as a collaborative platform to advance
Gene and Cell Therapy (GCT) in the UK.

We proactively foster cooperation among stakeholders, including the public, patients, scientists,
companies, government, and media to support the optimal development of GCT technologies and
therapies.

Our charity is managed by volunteer members via an Elected-Board and Sub-Committees. We rely on the
crucial support of our sponsors and members and invite you to get involved.

WHO WE ARE

The Innovate UK Catapult Network provides a unique combination of cutting-edge R&D facilities and
world-class technical expertise to support UK business innovation. Catapults are a critical element
of Innovate UK’s portfolio of products and services, where the application of research is
accelerated, and where new technologies are further developed, scaled up and realised. The Catapult
Network is made up of nine world-leading technology and innovation centres with more than 65
national locations.

[ Learn more about Innovate UK ][61]

on the map.

WHAT WE DO

The Innovate UK Catapult Network provides access to cutting-edge research and development facilities
and innovation ecosystems to support businesses with new innovations, from concept through to
adoption in the marketplace. The Catapult Network fosters collaborations between academia and
industry to produce new science-backed knowledge and solutions that drive positive change, create
jobs and stimulate investment.
